validation.footAnchorMethod: Measured lower 22% opaque shoe span midpoint and lowest opaque foot pixel +1; anchors remain source-relative.
validation.visualReview: Four directions, three low shuffle poses and sit reviewed. Frog separated with full dark outline and three-pixel transparent erase margin in all sixteen poses. Explicit source seams protect touching skirt pixels; no costume fragments in extracted frogs. Original PNG unchanged. Owner foot reference excludes frog. Runtime world-ground companion QA required before deployment.

ownerFootReview.method: Exclusive owner alpha region excludes separately measured frog even where outlines join. Neutral owner foot ground center is registered to upper head mass in x/y; original low-foot isometric fore/aft projection retained. Original PNG unchanged.

companionSeparation.relativeGroundOffsetCoordinateSystem: screen x/y scaled by nominal standing height
companionSeparation.runtimeRequirement: Erase frog polygon from body, clip extracted frog with same polygon, then draw at world-ground independently of seated hip.

outerOutlineReview.method: Expanded dark outline and three-source-pixel low-alpha margin; source seam protects touching costume. Extracted frogs and body-only crops visually checked in all sixteen poses.

validation.seatReview: Manually compared all four seated views beside the selected wanderer on identical existing chair geometry, same uniform standing scale and rear foreground masks; head/body mass and pelvis contact reviewed.
